what: Fig 2G printed pKa (raster legend, read by eye) vs Table S3 pKa (EMF glyph records, read by stage02_si_tables.py)
why_this_matters: two independent renderings, two independent extraction paths, and different decimal separators. A 9/9 exact agreement validates the EMF glyph transcription against something outside it; one misread digit in the SI table would break it.
what_it_does_NOT_validate: the Fig 4G bar geometry. pKa is printed text in both places; nothing here touches a measured pixel.
